registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register for enable and safety supervision configuration.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Global controller enable. When deasserted, command acceptance is inhibited and actuator_valid is deasserted.

fields.name: fault_clear_req
fields.description: Explicit fault-clear request. Honored only when the controller is in a safe idle condition per the design contract.

fields.name: clamp_enable
fields.description: Enables absolute actuator clamping before output update.

fields.name: rate_limit_enable
fields.description: Enables rate-of-change limiting in addition to absolute clamp bounds.

fields.name: reject_out_of_range
fields.description: When set, velocity outside the 20 to 55 m/s inclusive envelope is rejected and inhibited.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: timeout_cycles
fields.description: Response timeout threshold in clk cycles. If no valid response/update arrives before expiration, timeout fault is latched and actuator validity is inhibited.

fields.name: freshness_cycles
fields.description: Maximum allowed age in clk cycles for accepting a command as fresh.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: actuator_min
fields.description: Minimum permitted sanitized actuator command value.

fields.name: rate_down_min
fields.description: Maximum allowed negative rate step per update when rate limiting is enabled.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: actuator_max
fields.description: Maximum permitted sanitized actuator command value.

fields.name: rate_up_max
fields.description: Maximum allowed positive rate step per update when rate limiting is enabled.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: FALLBACK_CFG
registers.description: Observability and inhibit-policy configuration. This register does not generate a substitute command; it only selects bounded inhibit behavior metadata and safe output observability bits.

fields.name: fallback_mode
fields.description: Bounded inhibit-behavior mode selector used for observability and safe-state policy metadata. It does not create a substitute actuator command.

fields.name: hold_last_safe
fields.description: If set, retains the last safe sanitized command value for diagnostic reporting only; actuator_valid remains deasserted on faults.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: state_code
fields.description: Current controller state encoding.

fields.name: fault_latched
fields.description: Latched fault indication.

fields.name: timeout_active
fields.description: Indicates timeout supervision is active or has expired.

fields.name: fallback_active
fields.description: Indicates the controller is in inhibited safe handling rather than asserting a valid actuator update.

fields.name: clamp_active
fields.description: Indicates the most recent accepted command required clamping.

fields.name: valid_active
fields.description: Mirrors actuator_valid status.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: last_accepted_seq
fields.description: Sequence number of the last accepted command.

fields.name: last_fault_code
fields.description: Encoded reason for the most recent latched fault.

fields.name: last_rejected_seq
fields.description: Sequence number of the most recently rejected command, if any.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: last_sanitized_cmd
fields.description: Most recently sanitized actuator command value.

fields.name: last_applied_cmd
fields.description: Most recently applied command value when actuator_valid was asserted.

fields.name: seq_echo
fields.description: Sequence echo associated with the current/most recent command transaction.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

registers.name: FAULT_CLEAR
registers.description: Explicit software-managed fault-clear control. Writes are only accepted when the controller is back in a safe idle state and the clear key matches the implementation constant.

fields.name: clear_key
fields.description: Key value required to request fault clear.

fields.name: clear_valid
fields.description: Write-one strobe indicating that clear_key should be sampled.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Reserved, reads as zero.

fields.name: ip_version
fields.description: Implementation version identifier.

fields.name: build_id
fields.description: Build or integration identifier.

init_sequence: Deassert reset and verify STATUS0.valid_active=0 and STATUS0.fault_latched as expected.
Program LIMITS_MIN.actuator_min and LIMITS_MAX.actuator_max, plus optional rate limits.
Configure CONTROL.enable, CONTROL.clamp_enable, CONTROL.rate_limit_enable, and CONTROL.reject_out_of_range as required by the application.
Optionally write FALLBACK_CFG for observability/inhibit policy metadata only.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS1 for last accepted sequence, last fault code, and last rejected sequence.
Read STATUS2 for sanitization and sequence-echo observability.
Use VERSION to confirm software/bitstream compatibility.
irq_sequence: No interrupt sources are defined by DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON; use polling or a higher-level system interrupt wrapper if desired.

consistency_notes: All register names, offsets, field widths, and access types are compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The bus is a custom firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface with 64-bit data and 8-bit address control signals as declared in the spec.
No new hierarchy or ports are invented.
No substitute actuator command is implied by this register map; invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions inhibit actuator validity and latch fault status for software handling.
